name: project_page
title: Project Page
summary: Whole project page built from the post data.
description: Whole project page (replaces section_layout_aside + project_feature_hero): project_hero, project_taxonomy_marquee, section_nav (links to the sections that rendered + scroll progress), then the sections built from the post data - overview, screens (website screenshots), brand (web media), gallery (photos), videos - and its children (case studies = block_highlight, project_related, any component). Sets the post colors and the page palette (--project-*) for light and dark mode.
